content: चित्र {%a.%} [चित्र्-भावे अच्; चि-ष्ट्रन् वा <ls>Uṇ. 4. 163</ls>] .²1 Bright, clear. .²2 Variegated, spotted, diversified. .²3 amusing, interesting, agreeable; <ls>Māl. 1. 4</ls>. .²4 Various, different, manifold; <ls>Pt. 1. 136</ls>; <ls>Ms. 9. 248</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 288</ls>. .²5 Surprising, wonderful, strange; किमत्र चित्रम् <ls>R. 5. 33</ls>; <ls>Ś. 2. 15</ls>. .²6 Perceptible, visible. .²7 Conspicuous, excellent, distinguished; न यद्वचश्चित्रपदं हरेर्यशो जगत्पवित्रं प्रगृणीत कर्हिचित् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 5. 10</ls>. .²8 Rough, agitated (as the sea, <ab>opp.</ab> सम). .²9 Clear, loud, perceptible (as a sound). .{@-त्रः@} .²1 The variegated colour. .²2 A form of Yama. .²3 The Aśoka tree. .²4 = चित्रगुप्त <ab>q. v.</ab> below. .{@-त्रम्@} .²1 A picture, painting, delineation चित्रे निवेश्य परिकल्पितसत्त्वयोगा <ls>Ś. 2. 9</ls>; पुनरपि चित्रीकृता कान्ता <ls>Ś. 6. 20</ls>, <ls n="Ś. 6.">13</ls>, <ls n="Ś. 6.">21</ls> <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A brilliant ornament or ornament. .²3 An extraordinary appearance, wonder. .²4 A sectarial mark on the forehead. .²5 Heaven, sky. .²6 A spot. .²7 The white or spotted leprosy. .²8 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) The last of the three main divisions of {%Kāvya%} (poetry). (It is of two kinds शब्दचित्र and अर्थ-वाच्य-चित्र, and the poetical charm lies mainly in the use of figures of speech dependent on the sound and sense of words. Mammata thus defines it:-- शब्दचित्रं वाच्यचित्रमव्यङ्ग्यं त्ववरं स्मृतम् <ls>K. P. 1</ls>. As an instance of शब्दचित्र may be cited the following verse from <ls>R. G.</ls> मित्रात्रिपुत्रनेत्राय त्रयीशात्रवशत्रवे . गोत्रारिगोत्रजैत्राय गोत्रात्रे ते नमो नमः ..) .²9 Anything bright which strikes the eye. .²10 Playing upon words, punning, using conundrums, riddles <ab>&c.</ab> .²11 A lotus … … मङ्गले तिलके हेम्नि व्योम्नि पद्मे नपुंसकम् . <ls>Nm.</ls> .{@-त्रम्@} {%ind.%} Oh!, how strange!, what a wonder! चित्रं बधिरो नाम व्याकरणमध्येष्यते <ls>Sk.</ls>
